title: [PowerDisplay] Follow built-in display brightness on external monitors

proposed_comments.title: Keep ignored brightness events off the UI logging path

confidence.rationale: The dispatcher entry, suppression branch and auto-flushing file listener are directly established. This is narrowly unwanted hot-path logging; user-visible latency has not been measured.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep ignored brightness events off the UI logging path

**Severity:** `low`

This dispatcher-thread handler emits an informational entry for every brightness change ignored during profile/restore suppression. `ManagedCommon.Logger` uses an auto-flushing file trace listener, so holding brightness keys during that window produces repeated file logging for events that intentionally do no work. Please remove this `Logger.LogInfo` call and keep the existing `return`; actual-apply and error diagnostics can remain.
